part-name.purpose: The h1 of a part card only.

page-title.purpose: h1 on every other screen; home hero is a one-off 36/44px.

next-step.purpose: The single recommendation; loudest body text on the page, max 32ch.

section-heading.purpose: Same size as body; weight does the work.

body.purpose: Paragraphs max 65ch, relaxed leading; row summaries at weight 500.

meta.purpose: Dates, locations, helper copy, dl labels; always muted.

reading-value.purpose: Geist Mono with tabular-nums for readings, hours, tag ids.

shadows.name: dialog-backdrop
shadows.purpose: Backdrop of the native dialog. The only darkening on a page surface.

shadows.name: live-glass
shadows.purpose: Glass panels over camera video in /ar only. Never on a page background.

motion.name: colors
motion.purpose: transition-colors on every button, chip and segment.

motion.name: reduced-motion
motion.purpose: All animation and transition durations collapse under prefers-reduced-motion.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: One per page: the thing the visitor came to do. Cat yellow fill, ink text.
components.css: .ds-btn { display:inline-flex; min-height:48px; align-items:center; justify-content:center; gap:8px; padding:0 20px; border-radius:4px; font: 500 16px/1.5 Geist, system-ui, sans-serif; cursor:pointer; transition: background-color 150ms, border-color 150ms; border:1px solid transparent; } .ds-btn-primary { background: var(--accent, #ffcd11); color: var(--accent-ink, #111111); } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background:#f0bf0a; } .ds-btn-primary:active { background:#e3b400; } .ds-btn:focus-visible { outline:2px solid var(--foreground, #111); outline-offset:2px; } .ds-btn:disabled { opacity:.5; cursor:not-allowed; }

components.name: Secondary Button
components.description: The alternative to the primary. Ink border, transparent fill, surface wash on hover.
components.css: .ds-btn { display:inline-flex; min-height:48px; align-items:center; justify-content:center; gap:8px; padding:0 20px; border-radius:4px; font: 500 16px/1.5 Geist, system-ui, sans-serif; cursor:pointer; transition: background-color 150ms, border-color 150ms; } .ds-btn-secondary { background:transparent; color:var(--foreground,#111); border:1px solid var(--foreground,#111); } .ds-btn-secondary:hover { background:var(--surface,#f6f6f6); } .ds-btn:focus-visible { outline:2px solid var(--foreground,#111); outline-offset:2px; }

components.name: Ghost Button
components.description: Everything else that is a button. Line border; muted border and surface wash on hover.
components.css: .ds-btn { display:inline-flex; min-height:48px; align-items:center; justify-content:center; gap:8px; padding:0 20px; border-radius:4px; font: 500 16px/1.5 Geist, system-ui, sans-serif; cursor:pointer; transition: background-color 150ms, border-color 150ms; } .ds-btn-ghost { background:transparent; color:var(--foreground,#111); border:1px solid var(--line,#eaeaea); } .ds-btn-ghost:hover { border-color:var(--muted,#5f5f5f); background:var(--surface,#f6f6f6); } .ds-btn:focus-visible { outline:2px solid var(--foreground,#111); outline-offset:2px; }

components.name: Field
components.description: Text input, textarea and select share one look: 1px line border, ground fill, ink border on focus.
components.css: .ds-field-label { display:flex; flex-direction:column; gap:6px; font: 500 14px/1.43 Geist, system-ui, sans-serif; color:var(--foreground,#111); } .ds-field { min-height:48px; width:100%; padding:0 12px; border-radius:4px; border:1px solid var(--line,#eaeaea); background:var(--background,#fff); color:var(--foreground,#111); font: 400 16px/1.5 Geist, system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-field::placeholder { color:var(--muted,#5f5f5f); } .ds-field:hover { border-color:var(--muted,#5f5f5f); } .ds-field:focus-visible { border-color:var(--foreground,#111); outline:2px solid var(--foreground,#111); outline-offset:2px; } .ds-field[aria-invalid=true] { border-color:var(--alert,#b42318); }

components.name: Status Mark
components.description: A dot and a word. Status is a text colour, never a fill.
components.html: Needs attention Running normal No readings
components.css: .ds-status { display:inline-flex; align-items:center; gap:8px; white-space:nowrap; font: 500 16px/1.5 Geist, system-ui, sans-serif; margin-right:16px; } .ds-status-dot { width:8px; height:8px; border-radius:9999px; background:currentColor; flex-shrink:0; } .ds-status-ok { color:var(--ok,#1f7a3d); } .ds-status-watch { color:var(--watch,#9a5b00); } .ds-status-alert { color:var(--alert,#b42318); } .ds-status-none { color:var(--muted,#5f5f5f); } .ds-status-none .ds-status-dot { background:transparent; border:1px solid currentColor; }

components.name: Filter Chip
components.description: Dashboard status filter. Off is a line border; on inverts to ink, not yellow.
components.css: .ds-chip { min-height:40px; padding:0 12px; border-radius:4px; border:1px solid var(--line,#eaeaea); background:transparent; color:var(--foreground,#111); font: 500 14px/1.43 Geist, system-ui, sans-serif; white-space:nowrap; cursor:pointer; transition: background-color 150ms, border-color 150ms; margin-right:8px; } .ds-chip:hover { border-color:var(--muted,#5f5f5f); background:var(--surface,#f6f6f6); } .ds-chip-on, .ds-chip-on:hover { border-color:var(--foreground,#111); background:var(--foreground,#111); color:var(--background,#fff); } .ds-chip-count { font-variant-numeric:tabular-nums; opacity:.6; } .ds-chip:focus-visible { outline:2px solid var(--foreground,#111); outline-offset:2px; }

components.name: Role Toggle
components.description: Two-segment View-as switch. The only accent-filled toggle in the system.
components.css: .ds-toggle { display:grid; grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr; padding:4px; border:1px solid var(--line,#eaeaea); border-radius:4px; width:max-content; } .ds-seg { min-height:44px; padding:0 20px; border:0; border-radius:2px; background:transparent; color:var(--muted,#5f5f5f); font: 500 14px/1.43 Geist, system-ui, sans-serif; cursor:pointer; transition: color 150ms, background-color 150ms; } .ds-seg:hover { color:var(--foreground,#111); } .ds-seg-on, .ds-seg-on:hover { background:var(--accent,#ffcd11); color:var(--accent-ink,#111); } .ds-seg:focus-visible { outline:2px solid var(--foreground,#111); outline-offset:2px; }

components.name: Ruled Row
components.description: The list item. A 1px rule below, no box; tappable rows wash with surface on hover and carry a chevron.
components.html: 1. Main hydraulic pump Right side, under coverCase drain flow 9.2 L/min, Needs attention
components.css: .ds-list { list-style:none; margin:0; padding:0; border-top:1px solid var(--line,#eaeaea); font-family: Geist, system-ui, sans-serif; color:var(--foreground,#111); } .ds-row { display:flex; align-items:flex-start; gap:12px; min-height:56px; padding:14px 0; border-bottom:1px solid var(--line,#eaeaea); cursor:pointer; } .ds-row:hover { background:var(--surface,#f6f6f6); } .ds-row-dot { margin-top:7px; width:8px; height:8px; border-radius:9999px; background:currentColor; flex-shrink:0; } .ds-row-dot-alert { color:var(--alert,#b42318); } .ds-row-body { flex:1; min-width:0; display:block; } .ds-row-title { display:block; font-weight:500; font-size:16px; line-height:1.375; } .ds-row-meta { font-weight:400; font-size:14px; color:var(--muted,#5f5f5f); margin-left:8px; } .ds-row-sub { display:block; margin-top:2px; font-size:14px; color:var(--muted,#5f5f5f); } .ds-row-chev { width:16px; height:16px; margin-top:6px; color:var(--muted,#5f5f5f); flex-shrink:0; transition: transform 200ms; }

narrative.overview: One neutral ground, 1px rules to divide it, one yellow thing to press. Content is set in Geist and the hierarchy is carried by size and weight, not by boxes, tints or shadows. Every screen is a column of ruled sections; status is a coloured dot and a word, never a fill. Both colour schemes come free from prefers-color-scheme; nothing is hard-coded except Cat yellow.

rules.name: The One Yellow Rule
rules.body: A page has one yellow control: the thing the visitor came to do. A second action is btnSecondary (ink border), everything else is btnGhost. State switches (filter chips) invert to ink, not yellow.

rules.name: The Dot Not Fill Rule
rules.body: Status never tints a background, border or row. It is StatusMark (8px dot + word) or a 6px dot + short word at 12px inside readings.

rules.name: The Weight Not Size Rule
rules.body: Adjacent levels differ by weight or colour before they differ by size; no uppercase, no letter-spaced labels, no eyebrows above headings.

dos: Do compose from ui.ts, StatusMark and icons.tsx; new screens should add no new colour, radius or shadow.
Do separate content with border-t border-line sections and border-b rows; let 48px gaps breathe.
Do spend yellow once per page, on the primary action, and keep it on the role toggle, dictation state, "Just saved" and the "Next step" square.
Do keep every tappable thing at least 44px tall and make every hover state also work without hover.
Do use Geist Mono + tabular-nums for numbers that line up (readings, hours, tag ids).
donts: Don't put content in nested cards or rounded tinted boxes; the dashboard notice (border border-line bg-surface) is the only bordered box, and it is flat.
Don't use status colour as a fill, pill, badge or coloured left border; dot + word only.
Don't add shadows or gradients outside the dialog backdrop and the live camera overlays.
Don't write eyebrows, kickers, uppercase or letter-spaced labels above headings.
Don't use emoji, glyph fonts or icon packages; draw the icon in icons.tsx.
Don't hard-code hex or Tailwind palette colours (neutral-*, red-*) on page UI; use the tokens so dark mode holds.
